## Summary

I've implemented the chore to replace outfit card thumbnails with flat-lay LOOKs images. Here's what was done:

### Work Completed:
- **Updated `Outfit` type** (`lib/types.ts`): Added `flatLayImageUrl`, `flatLayImageBase64`, and `isGeneratingFlatLay` properties to support flat-lay images in outfit cards

- **Redesigned `OutfitRecommendationCard`** (`components/chat/OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx`):
  - Changed image area from small 20x24 thumbnail to full-width square aspect ratio container
  - Added loading skeleton with animated dots while flat-lay is generating
  - Uses `object-contain` for flat-lay images to show full composition
  - Falls back to product thumbnail if flat-lay generation fails
  - Kept all existing button functionality (ดูลุค, heart, share)

- **Refactored `ChatAssistant`** (`components/chat/ChatAssistant.tsx`):
  - Created `generateFlatLayForOutfit()` helper function that generates flat-lay and updates outfit in-place
  - Outfits are now marked with `isGeneratingFlatLay: true` immediately when received
  - Flat-lay images are embedded directly in the outfit cards (no separate LooksInspiration message)
  - Removed the code that created separate image messages after outfit cards
  - Added proper error handling - falls back to thumbnail on generation failure
